item.summary: The Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), jointly with the National Housing Bank (NHB), spearheaded “PMAY-G Reform Samvad”, a one-day stakeholder dialogue on reforms for strengthening rural housing under PMAY-G. It brought together MoRD, NHB, State Rural Development Departments, the World Bank, International Finance Corporation, Sa-Dhan, TCIS Habitat for Humanity International and lending…
item.title: Lending Institutions propose institutional financing of PMAY-G beneficiaries at MoRD–NHB “PMAY-G Reform Samvad” in Lonavala: States, HFCs, SFBs, MFIs and RRBs deliberate a roadmap for affordable institutional credit for rural housing
